artifact_source: Fresh component and Platform ZIP extraction per stage; source validation before commit. Rebuild after commit changes host identity and requires paired modules.
coverage: SQLite, PostgreSQL 18.6, SQL Server 2025 Developer, Dameng DM8 business and safety cases
Exact numbers, binary, Unicode/BOM, ordered metadata, import/export, commit/rollback and affected-row guards
Each real external engine queried with only its own module installed
Three real engines: 50 read-only launches each with six concurrent workers, cancellation, parent death and recovery
Four vendor modules: offline full runtime-graph encode/decode equality, isolated initialization and repeated package byte equality
Canonical host rebuild equality, toolchain/platform checks and stable digest during packing
Root normal build/test and native PostgreSQL, Oracle, DM, SQL Server, ODBC module tests
Loader ordering, relative-host target copies, far CMP widths, zero-size symbols, conservative prelink and malformed-format tests

generic_retention_experiments.reason: Full candidate repeated x/text plural registration on Windows. Reduced candidates passed initialization but increased installed size. Vendor/message/encoding code remains optional inside modules.

limitations: No live Oracle or MySQL server
ODBC native tests passed; no real vendor ODBC session
No macOS hardware: OS-thread JIT/signing adaptations not runtime-verified
Go internal ABI remains experimental; exact host SHA-256 required
Disk/ZIP sizes are not runtime memory measurements
